name: Bandou Shin'ichi
source:
The props master for "The Wandering Angels."

He helped [url=/c129987]Yukio Tozuka[/url] in resolving the problem regarding the [url=/c93374]debt[/url] [url=/c93375]collectors[/url] harassing their actor Akiomi Mondo. After the show's production, Bando noticed that the dry ice machine purchased from [url=/c74743]Endo Electronics[/url] was malfunctioning and wouldn't stop producing dry ice. The show's producer, [url=/c129739]Sukozawa[/url], sent Bando, Tozuka, and the novice actor [url=/c129988]Takuya Amo[/url] to return the ice machine.

[Edited from in-game TIPS]

[spoiler]Once [url=/c73543]Minorikawa[/url] informed them that they could discard the dry ice machine, the trio allowed [url=/c73541]Kano[/url] to take it, using it to deactivate [url=/c74615]Alphard[/url]'s bomb and save the Scramble.[/spoiler]
